why: Номинализация — это превращение глагола или прилагательного в существительное: decide → decision, fail → failure. В академических статьях, отчётах и деловых письмах так звучит солидно и сжато: вместо «люди потеряли доверие» пишут «произошла потеря доверия». В русском то же самое называют «отглагольными существительными» (внедрение, рост, отказ).
formation: • глагол → существительное через суффиксы: -tion/-sion (introduce → introduction, decide → decision), -ment (develop → development), -al (refuse → refusal, arrive → arrival), -ure (fail → failure), -ence/-ance (depend → dependence, perform → performance), -ing (the meeting)
• неправильные пары: analyze → analysis, grow → growth, choose → choice, solve → solution, rise → rise (форма та же)
• прилагательное → существительное: able → ability, different → difference, safe → safety, efficient → efficiency
• схема: The + (прилагательное) + существительное + предлог + объект: the rapid development of the tool
usage: 1. Чтобы сжать два предложения в одно: Prices rose sharply. This worried investors. → The sharp rise in prices worried investors. (Резкий рост цен встревожил инвесторов.)
2. Чтобы сделать главным подлежащим процесс или факт, а не человека: The decision to cancel the event disappointed everyone. (Решение отменить мероприятие разочаровало всех.)
3. В академическом и деловом стиле вместо разговорных глаголов: An investigation into the decline in sales was conducted. (Было проведено расследование причин падения продаж.)
4. С глаголами-связками result in, lead to, cause, contribute to: The introduction of caching led to improved performance. (Внедрение кэширования привело к росту производительности.)
Каждое существительное тянет за собой «свой» предлог: increase IN, demand FOR, solution TO, dependence ON, decision TO + инфинитив.
signalWords: Чаще всего в таком тексте встречаются: lead to, result in, cause, contribute to, due to, as a result of, the impact of, the effect of, the role of.
mistakes: ✗ The decide to close the office → ✓ The decision to close the office (после the нужно существительное)
✗ There was a rise of prices → ✓ There was a rise in prices (rise IN, а не OF)
✗ The development of technologies are fast → ✓ The development of technology is rapid (подлежащее development, глагол единственного числа)
✗ Their refuse to help → ✓ Their refusal to help (refuse глагол, refusal существительное)
✗ Using nominalization everywhere in an email → ✓ Use it for formal writing, but keep speech and chat simple (в разговоре это звучит напыщенно)
remember: Глагол → существительное + предлог: «Prices rose» превращается в «the rise in prices», и предложение звучит формально.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте слово в скобках в форму существительного

items.prompt: The government announced the ___ (introduce) of a new tax.
The ___ (fail) of the system surprised everyone.
Her ___ (resign) was unexpected.
The ___ (develop) of the app took six months.
We are worried about the ___ (reduce) in sales.
His ___ (arrive) caused a stir.
The ___ (analyze) of the data showed a clear trend.
Their ___ (refuse) to cooperate delayed the project.

exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, более подходящий для формального письма

items.prompt: (a) We looked into why sales dropped. (b) An investigation into the decline in sales was conducted.
(a) A lot of people don't trust banks any more. (b) There has been a growing distrust of banks.
(a) The introduction of caching led to improved performance. (b) When we introduced caching, the app ran better.
(a) Because prices rose, people bought less. (b) The rise in prices resulted in reduced consumption.
(a) It is important that people communicate well. (b) Effective communication is essential.
(a) Employees are happier, so they work harder. (b) Increased employee satisfaction leads to higher productivity.
(a) The study shows that many people are moving to cities. (b) The study shows an increase in migration to urban areas.
(a) The implementation of the new policy was delayed. (b) They put off putting the new policy into practice.

exercises.instruction: Объедините два предложения в одно с существительным в скобках

items.prompt: Prices rose sharply. This worried investors. (rise)
items.answer: The sharp rise in prices worried investors.

items.prompt: They failed to deliver on time. This caused a problem. (failure)
items.answer: Their failure to deliver on time caused a problem.

items.prompt: The engineers developed the tool quickly. This impressed us. (development)
items.answer: The quick development of the tool impressed us.

items.prompt: Many people criticized the plan. This surprised the mayor. (criticism)
items.answer: The widespread criticism of the plan surprised the mayor.

items.prompt: Companies depend heavily on cloud services. This is a risk. (dependence)
items.answer: The heavy dependence of companies on cloud services is a risk. / Companies' heavy dependence on cloud services is a risk.

items.prompt: The committee decided to cancel the event. This disappointed everyone. (decision)
items.answer: The committee's decision to cancel the event disappointed everyone.

items.prompt: The temperature rose gradually. This affected the crops. (increase)
items.answer: The gradual increase in temperature affected the crops.

items.prompt: Scientists discovered a new planet. This changed our view of space. (discovery)
items.answer: The discovery of a new planet changed our view of space.

items.prompt: There has been a sharp ___ (rise) ___ house prices.
Our ___ (depend) ___ foreign suppliers is a problem.
The ___ (solve) ___ this problem is not easy to find.
His ___ (reply) ___ the email was very late.
There is a growing ___ (demand) ___ qualified developers.
Her ___ (interest) ___ artificial intelligence began at university.
The ___ (reason) ___ the delay is still unclear.
Their ___ (approach) ___ the problem was very practical.
Внедрение новой системы заняло три месяца.
items.answer: The implementation of the new system took three months.

items.prompt: Рост цен привёл к снижению спроса.
items.answer: The rise in prices led to a decrease in demand. / The rise in prices led to a fall in demand.

items.prompt: Отказ компании сотрудничать удивил всех.
items.answer: The company's refusal to cooperate surprised everyone.

items.prompt: Быстрое развитие технологий меняет рынок труда.
items.answer: The rapid development of technology is changing the labor market.

items.prompt: Решение закрыть офис было трудным.
items.answer: The decision to close the office was difficult.

items.prompt: Улучшение связи повысило эффективность работы.
items.answer: The improvement in communication increased the efficiency of the work. / The improvement in communication increased work efficiency.

items.prompt: Недавнее открытие помогло учёным понять причину болезни.
items.answer: A recent discovery helped scientists understand the cause of the disease.

items.prompt: Задержка поставок вызвала недовольство клиентов.
items.answer: The delay in deliveries caused customer dissatisfaction. / The delay in deliveries caused dissatisfaction among customers.
